results.title: From watching cartoons to creating comics: Edgar Soghomonyan’s artistic journey
results.description: When Edgar Soghomonyan was still a toddler, his mother turned on the television, and he watched a Soviet-era cartoon for the first time. There were no special effects or fast-paced action. But for him, it opened the door to a world that still inspires him today. His creative journey, however, began not with animation, but ... The post From watching cartoons to creating comics: Edgar Soghomonyan’s artistic journey appeared first on The Armenian Weekly .
